title: Document Review Copilot
subtitle: Turn versioned rules and evidence into a verified draft for a named human reviewer.
author: By Sourav Banerjee

practice_prompts.label: Architecture and trust boundaries
practice_prompts.hint: Trace one case and each failure gate.

practice_prompts.label: Decisions and alternatives
practice_prompts.hint: Explain what you chose and when you would revisit it.

practice_prompts.label: Evaluation, rollout and ownership

rubric: I kept the final decision with a named professional.
I carried source spans and versions in the extraction schema.
I blocked missing critical pages/tables and selected effective rules.
I separated extraction, grounding, citation and escalation tests.
I bounded sensitive data, model cost and staged rollout.
